objective: Verify exact already-retained bundle and separately supplied SBOM/provenance/build lock bytes against the frozen retained manifest and out-of-band manifest digest, without generating or publishing artifacts.
nonGoals: No signed SLSA provenance verification or SBOM contents parsing
No rebuild during promotion, live release or immutable remote custody claim
No installer, deployment, repository workflow or settings changes
decisions: Retrieve existing content-addressed release bytes and independently rehash the declared build-manifest/SBOM/provenance/toolchain files.
Report byte binding only; a locally supplied SBOM/provenance with matching hashes is unauthenticated and cannot satisfy production release policy.

obligations.description: Reject replaced SBOM/provenance/toolchain bytes, missing file, stale manifest or changed retained archive
Verify out-of-band manifest hash before trusting metadata; reject unsafe alias and symlinked input
No production or signing claim without real provider and independently held release policy

structure: tests/test_artifact_audit.py changed bytes and policy negative cases
impact: Independent read-only API over caller-owned local retention store

budget.network: No external artifact APIs, repository writes only
budget.execution: Run normal PR CI once on stable head

externalEffects: No publication or mutable adopter target; only stacked PR
